name: Sheal
overview: Sheal is a male figure identified as a descendant of Bani, notable for having married a foreign wife. Beyond this unique attribute, Scripture does not provide additional details regarding his tribe or other personal notes.
namesAndTitles: The name Sheal means 'May God grant!' or 'asking,' reflecting a Hebrew proper name. This meaning emphasizes a petition or request directed toward God, though the name was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Sheal as a descendant of Bani. No further family relationships are documented beyond this connection and his marriage to a foreign wife.
scriptureSignificance: Sheal's significance in the biblical narrative centers on his status as a descendant of Bani who married a foreign wife, a fact noted in the post-exilic community context. This detail highlights issues related to intermarriage and covenant faithfulness among the returned exiles, underscoring the challenges faced in maintaining purity of worship and community identity.
